events.title: "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic "White Album" was released on this day in 1968, making it 58 years old.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped what would become one of their most influential and debated albums. Double vinyl, no less.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock legend. Still no one quite like him.

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965, making it 61 years old.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turning Point
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a turning point in their sound. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years on. His music and message continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie, born in London on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: The Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, born January 8, 1935, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Happy Heavenly Birthday King
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to The King. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his legacy is still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin axe-man, Jimmy Page. Still inspiring guitarists worldwide.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, born January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sir Rod
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today. Still got that unmistakable voice, still packing out arenas.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born January 13, 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness. Still bringing the house down with those ska anthems.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, born January 17, 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young. 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' still sounds incredible.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born January 19, 1946, would have been 81 today.

angles.name: Happy Heavenly Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton. A true queen of country, and so much more.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow, born January 20, 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow. From boyband heartthrob to national treasure.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B singer Billy Ocean, born January 21, 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy
angles.copy: Get out those dancing shoes! Billy Ocean turns 77 today. Still 'Caribbean Queen' in our hearts.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, making it 38 years ago.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Firsts
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its first class of legends. Who would be in your dream induction list?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born January 27, 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen. Still got that boyish charm.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the Apple Corps rooftop on this day in 1969, making it 58 years ago.

angles.name: Rooftop Finale
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their final live performance. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins, born January 30, 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins. Still 'In The Air Tonight' for us.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 66
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, born September 9, 1960, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the king of British rom-coms, Hugh Grant. Still charming us all.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born January 31, 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday JT
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. From *NSYNC to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason, born February 2, 1940, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Del Boy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only Sir David Jason. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959, an event known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Remembering The Music
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years on from "The Day The Music Died". Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, born February 6, 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick
angles.copy: Never gonna give up on wishing a happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley. Still got those moves!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born February 6, 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Heavenly Birthday Bob
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the King of Reggae, Bob Marley. His message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born February 9, 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King. A true songwriting genius.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of global superstar Whitney Houston, who died in 2012.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, 15 years on. Her power and talent remain unmatched.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts across the nation, making it 31 years ago.

angles.name: Take That Breakup
angles.copy: 31 years ago today, the pop world collectively wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born February 15, 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40. Still bringing those sunshine reggae vibes.
